title: AI fabric Hugging Face to vLLM deployment
description: Phase 0 PSTF gate for the Slice 1 Hugging Face model import and GPU/vLLM deployment flow. Current executable product-path evidence remains non-production D4 harness evidence; production verification is now represented by an opt-in integration gate that requires real configured external dependencies.
in_scope: Endpoint state and smoke evaluation publication
Production verification prerequisites for Hugging Face artifacts, OCI/Blossom mirrors, vLLM runtime, gateway route, and Nostr relays
out_of_scope: HF resolver, vLLM adapter, UI, or gateway implementation
Creating fake production credentials, artifacts, hardware, or relay access
preconditions: Phase 0 protocol contract is under review.
Current executable behavior evidence is limited to local fake/no-network D4 harnesses.
Production verification requires real external prerequisites tracked by bahia-wiw9 and a compilable integration package tracked by bahia-iz8j.
postconditions: Acceptance criteria remain mapped to D4 harness tests that classify evidence as non-production.
Production integration verification is blocked until real prerequisites are supplied and TestAIHFVLLMProductionIntegrations passes.
PSTF evidence separates non-production harness evidence from blocked production evidence.
failure_paths: If BAHIA_HF_VLLM_PROD_VERIFY is unset, the production gate skips with the complete prerequisite list instead of fabricating evidence.
If BAHIA_HF_VLLM_PROD_VERIFY=1 but any required endpoint, digest, or relay credential is missing, the production gate fails with the exact missing prerequisite names.
non_functional_requirements: Nostr-native event-driven semantics; no HTTP polling as completion truth.
Production relay verification must validate per-relay OK/duplicate acceptance, EOSE catch-up, CLOSED reasons including AUTH, NIP-01 signatures, and scoped kind/author/#d/#t filters.

Production HTTP checks must prove the configured expected model id and stream configured artifact/mirror response bodies to compute local SHA-256 byte hashes; response digest headers are supplemental consistency evidence only and ETag is not treated as a SHA-256 proof.
